title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
titleZh: D-JEPA：决策对齐的潜在世界模型
short_description: D-JEPA aligns predictive world models with action selection. It learns decision-relevant relations among predicted futures, combines evidence from multiple predictive geometries, and writes this structure back into latent representations for robotic manipulation and autonomous driving.
shortDescriptionZh: D-JEPA 将预测式世界模型与动作选择对齐，学习预测未来之间与决策相关的关系，融合多种预测几何中的信息，并将决策结构写回潜在表征，服务于机器人操作与自动驾驶。
